name: Listen Live Plugin for FPP
author: jessica12ryan
description: Listen to your show's audio in the FPP UI. Frame-exact playback uses FPP's MultiSync clock with raw PCM blocks scheduled by Web Audio; playback auto-starts with FPP and the best-effort MP3 fallback streams the current media file before live capture. Includes live status and volume control. Captured audio is never stored and stays on your LAN.

privacy.summary: Streams FPP's audio to your browser on your LAN. Capture uses an output monitor/loopback or the device you choose in Config, which on some hardware is a microphone. Nothing is stored or sent off-box.

systemChanges.what: Sets FPP's restartFlag on install/uninstall so fppd reloads the native sync plugin

privacy.other: Camera access: none. The browser never requests camera or microphone permission. On the host, live capture uses ffmpeg with a PipeWire/PulseAudio monitor, an ALSA loopback, or the capture device chosen in Config; on hardware with a microphone attached, a fallback device may be a mic input. Captured audio is streamed only to browsers on your LAN and is never written to disk. Settings are stored by FPP in <mediadir>/config/plugin.fpp-ListenLive (not in the plugin directory); a legacy config/settings.json is migrated to <mediadir>/plugindata/fpp-ListenLive on install. Logs go to <mediadir>/logs/plugin-fpp-ListenLive.log. Your browser keeps its volume and Exact-sync toggle preferences in localStorage; mute is never saved.
